author: Greg
body:
2.5 stars.

I really wanted to like the this chair and did a ton of research before purchasing. The build quality feels solid, and I was genuinely excited when it arrived. I put it together right away. Unfortunately, after spending several hours trying to adjust it and convince myself it would work, it simply doesn’t fit my body type.

I’m 6’2”, and while the chair is advertised as having features that automatically adapt to different body types, I found that many of those features didn’t adapt well to me. The seat was very uncomfortable, and the mesh felt surprisingly cheap, hard, and unforgiving compared with what I expected from a chair at this price point.

The armrests were another disappointment. They feel jerky and are impossible to keep in position. Instead of being a helpful adjustment feature, they constantly move and become distracting.

I gave it several hours and tried every adjustment, but the more time I spent in it, the less comfortable I became. I will be returning it.
